## Evidence

## Checklist

- [ ] No NOR writes, no `INFORM0=3`, no raw disk commands (see `SAFETY.md`)
- [ ] No personal data: names, paths, serials, MAC addresses, PINs, hostnames
- [ ] No TomTom firmware, maps, NOR dumps or backups
- [ ] New source files carry an `SPDX-License-Identifier` line
- [ ] Lessons added to `docs/LESSONS.md` as symptom, cause, fix, where relevant
